name: make_booking
description: Make an outbound call to a restaurant or business to book a reservation for the visitor. Use this AFTER you have collected ALL required info: venue name, phone (from search_places), party size, date, time, visitor's full name, and visitor's phone number.

request_body_schema.description: Booking request details. Before calling, you MUST have collected: venueName and phoneNumber (from search_places), partySize, date, time, customerName (full name), and customerPhone (visitor's callback number).

venueName.description: Name of the venue (restaurant, hotel, activity provider) to call

phoneNumber.description: Phone number of the business (from search_places result)

partySize.description: Number of people for the reservation

date.description: Date for the reservation (e.g., 'hoy', 'mañana', 'el viernes', '15 de febrero')

time.description: Time for the reservation (e.g., '21:00', 'a las nueve de la noche')

customerName.description: Visitor's FULL NAME for the reservation (e.g., 'Juan García López')

customerPhone.description: Visitor's phone number for the restaurant to call back if needed (e.g., '612345678', '+34612345678')

specialRequests.description: Any special requests (e.g., 'trona para bebé', 'mesa en terraza', 'alergia al gluten')
